definitions.gloss: back alley; back street; side lane
definitions.explanation: A narrow street or alley behind or away from the main road. Can suggest hidden charm (a tucked-away restaurant) or seediness (a dark, deserted lane), depending on context.

examples.japanese: {裏路地|うらろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}んだ→迷い込む：17603_mayoikomu⟧。
examples.english: I wandered into a back alley.

examples.japanese: {裏路地|うらろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧⟦{名店|めいてん}→名店：21511_meiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a hidden gem of a restaurant in a back alley.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{裏路地|うらろじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: One street over from the tourist-packed road, a quiet back alley spread out before us.

notes:
A narrow lane behind or between main streets. In travel and food writing, {裏路地|うらろじ} often has a positive connotation — suggesting a charming, hidden-away spot. In crime or suspense contexts, it can suggest danger.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏路地|うらろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go into a back alley
- {裏路地|うらろじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a shop in a back alley
- {裏路地|うらろじ}⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: strolling through back alleys
- {裏路地|うらろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}い{込|こ}む→迷い込む：17603_mayoikomu⟧: to wander into a back alley

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧: alley, lane — more neutral; any narrow side street
- ⟦{裏通|うらどお}り→裏通り：09383_uradoori⟧: back street — slightly wider than an alley
- ⟦{横丁|よこちょう}→横丁：18976_yokochou⟧: side street, yokocho — often a short lane with shops or bars
